d:
"William Shake" is a high-energy rap anthem where Dharmik claims the title of Hyderabad’s “Dakhni Rap ka William Shake.” The song highlights his journey from humble beginnings to becoming a voice for Deccan rap. Through sharp wordplay and cultural pride, he blends local lingo with hard-hitting metaphors, emphasizing his artistic legacy and resilience. The track celebrates his roots, hustle, and impact on the southern rap scene, delivering a strong message about living fully while embracing life’s impermanence.
Song Credits
Track Name: William Shake
Written & Performed By: Dharmik
